saved mask comes from C9's run of /tmp/mhw.py (the C7 code). That script reads /tmp/sst.npz written in C6 and builds day-of-year pools, where concatenating along axis 0 merges all latitude rows into one per-longitude threshold that is broadcast to the cells. Only the smoothed thresholds for days of year 153–244 are used, so the baseline window of days 138–259 ±5 days covers May 12 to Sep 20 of each year, and all target days 2021-06-01 to 2021-08-31 for every region cell feed the sea mask and the hot comparison."}
